deviations.what: Reader line scroll: bottom keys 4.3 / 4.4 move the EPUB view one line back / forward, composing a window from the cached PageLine elements of adjacent pages (lib/Epub/Epub/Page.h:23-80) at the reader-activity level without changing layout; offset persists across page turns, resets on zoom/go-to; XTC stays page-only. Full X3 key map target: top button = zoom toggle, power = sleep/wake, left/right = page back/forward (zoom smaller/larger; tabs in Settings), 4.1 = Back/Cancel, 4.2 = Menu/OK, 4.3/4.4 = line back/forward in reader and option up/down in menus. Implemented after the key-diagnostic session measures the real X3 ADC mapping
deviations.reason: User request during X3 hands-on (2026-10-06): '4.3 move 1 line back, 4.4 move 1 line forward. Possible?' plus the 8-key layout description

deviations.what: Web UI on ebooks.culture.dev authenticates with Cloudflare Access SSO alone: the server verifies the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion RS256 JWT (team agentculture.cloudflareaccess.com JWKS, iss, aud = the ebooks.culture.dev Access app AUD, nbf/exp) and treats a valid token as an authenticated operator for the main-app /api routes; the UI skips the 'Connect this browser' key panel when an unauthenticated probe succeeds. API keys remain required for device (8781), MCP and plain LAN API clients. Verifier cited (cite-don't-import) from culture-rules culture_rules/auth/access.py (stdlib-only)
deviations.reason: User (2026-10-06): 'I thought i only use sso? https://ebooks.culture.dev/ I need an xtk api key' — the key panel was the agent's own interpretation of c77, flagged but shipped before the user answered

deviations.what: X3 key profile (measured with the XKEY logger 2026-10-07): left edge reads logical Up (adc2~2222), right edge logical Down (adc2~2), 4.1 Back (adc1~3515), 4.2 Confirm (~2686), 4.3 Left (~1486), 4.4 Right (~0); the top regular button is the chip's hardware reset (no ADC/GPIO change, full reboot) so it cannot be bound. Target on X3: edges = Left/Right (prev/next page; prev/next tab in Settings), 4.1 = Back (long-press in reader = rotate portrait<->landscape), 4.2 = Menu/OK (long-press in reader = zoom mode, edges step size), 4.3/4.4 = Up/Down (line back/forward in reader per d3; option up/down in menus). A reset boot (EN) boots normally to Home instead of going back to sleep. Supersedes 'top button = zoom toggle' (c40) and the top-button parts of d3
deviations.reason: User decisions after the key-logger session: rotate wanted on the top button, which measured as a hardware reset; user chose long-press Back for rotate, long-press OK for zoom, and normal boot after reset

deviations.what: Reader scroll is by paragraph, not by line: on the X3, 4.4 skips the rest of the paragraph at the top so the next paragraph starts at the top of the screen, and 4.3 brings the start of the paragraph above back to the top. A paragraph starts at a line whose gap from the line above is wider than 1.25 line pitches (Extra paragraph spacing adds half a line by default). The page's top line counts as a start, so no text is skipped. Supersedes the line-by-line step of d3 (fork 7f833be3, merged 43676ff6)
deviations.reason: Operator asked on 2026-10-07 after trying the d5 build: 'Can we change the next line, previous line to next paragraph, previous paragraph'
